The next step would be a structure that lets the A-order depend on t directly, for example a power A^(a+b·t) or an A-inhibition whose exponent varies with t.

def equation(t, A, params):

    return -(params[0]/t + params[1] + params[2]*t**2)*H + params[6]*A*t + params[7]*A**2 + params[8]*A/t + params[9]*A
